ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( LicenseType__c = DependentApplication__r.LicenseType__c, TEXT(Type__c) = "LICN - New License", OR( TEXT(Type__c) = "LICF - New License After Forfeiture" ) ), true, false )
